The official DoAA academic-programmes page states that it presently offers the listed undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral and eMasters programmes. Current official programme/admissions pages also show newer offerings, including B.Tech. in Intelligent Systems, Bachelors in Cybersecurity, an online M.Tech. in AIML, and additional July 2026 postgraduate disciplines, that are not fully reflected in the central catalogue.
Because the official catalogue is internally incomplete/inconsistent across the DoAA page and current programme pages, this record is manual_review with partial_official_website rather than verified.
No active diploma or certificate programme was identified in the official catalogue pages reviewed; short-term events and admission notices were excluded.

Duration and eligibility were left null unless the relevant official page explicitly stated them. Career mappings were checked against the read-only local career_nodes tree; nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings are labelled with medium/low confidence.
